_comment: The web's fixed lines (TD v0.40–v0.43, The web viewer). `public`: connections everyone knows, each with a type and one public line (Characters to write). `private`: each character's own connections, from their briefing's Relationships section, seen only by that character. Until Characters supplies this file, it holds only the playable character's own connections, copied from his briefing (Characters v0.11).

Francesco Pazzi.line: Your secret love. You'd risk a great deal for her.
Your family's enemy, and soft. He must not rule.
Piero's brother. A braggart, but at least he has nerve.
Your sister. Clever, and too quick to think she should lead.
A friar worth winning, if he can be bought without being trusted.
